policy: Each completed session: the default-profile ranking the page computes, top and bottom fifth recorded before outcomes exist; outcome = equal-weight mean adjusted-close return over each stock's next 21 completed sessions in its own market, measured from the ranking session's own close (no execution lag), no costs. Rank IC per market from the whole ranked order. Entries are keyed by the US session date: when the Korean market adds no session between two entries, both carry the same Korean session, so day averages repeat that Korean window. Evidence counts only non-overlapping entries (each starts after the previous one's forward window ends), which removes such repeats. Symbol lists kept 60 days; outcomes kept.
allowedUse: research-validation-record; not a trading signal or performance claim
